environment.profile: unique disposable /private/tmp directory; removed after run
environment.definition: Warm: fresh LeetCode tab in the same browser and worker. Cold: full browser restart with the same persisted disposable profile, then a fresh tab. Page marks and measures use their isolated-context clock; worker measures use the worker clock. Fixture restore and known-slug setup are untimed.

warm.attributionNote: Only RunTask records whose arguments identify the packaged extension are attributed; unattributed renderer tasks are excluded. Raw trace discarded.

cold.attributionNote: Only RunTask records whose arguments identify the packaged extension are attributed; unattributed renderer tasks are excluded. Raw trace discarded.

submit.reason: Disposable profile has no authenticated LeetCode session; real Submit and disabled-extension comparison were not sampled. No code was submitted.
